packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the single folder to serve, read-only. Wins over WYRD_GRANT. Any path inside it can be requested, hidden entries included, such as .env and .git/config, apart from a handful of name spellings refused as input: a drive-letter-and-colon prefix such as C:notes on every host, and on Windows a colon inside a component (which names a data stream rather than a file) or a reserved device name such as NUL.md. What comes back is narrower than what can be requested: a directory is refused, and so are bytes that are not valid UTF-8. That limits what is readable, not what is reachable; grant a subfolder containing only what you mean to share.

packageArguments.description: The solution to check. Optional, but supply it for most repositories: when omitted the server reads LOADBEARING_SOLUTION_PATH, then walks up from its working directory, which resolves only where exactly one .sln, .slnf or .slnx sits at or above that directory. It finds nothing where the solution is under src/, and refuses as ambiguous where several sit side by side. A solution file passed here beats both; a server that cannot bind still starts, returns the reason from every tool call, and names the CLI command that answers from the same model. A config generated from this manifest passes nothing here, so a repository the walk-up cannot resolve is bound at install time or its session works from the CLI alone, spelled through dnx because launching this way installs no loadbearing command.

environmentVariables.description: Path to the solution to check when no solution argument is passed. A config generated from this manifest passes none, so this is where a repository the walk-up cannot resolve binds: set it at install time, or the server starts unbound and its session works from the CLI alone, spelled through dnx because launching this way installs no loadbearing command.
environmentVariables.name: LOADBEARING_SOLUTION_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Solution to analyse when the working directory holds zero or several. The solutionPath tool argument overrides it for one call.

packageArguments.description: Optional. Site-supplied converter run instead of Oracle's frmf2xml: a whole command line with its arguments, quoting any part that contains spaces, or a JSON array of arguments. It is spawned directly, never through a shell; the module's path replaces {} and is appended when {} is absent, the output file's path replaces {out}, and the working directory is the converted directory (--converted-dir, else the module's cache directory), which is where it must write the text form unless it writes to {out}. Mount the converter into the container and point this at it. Also settable as OFMCP_CONVERT_COMMAND.

packageArguments.description: Optional. Converter for .pll libraries only, run instead of whatever would convert them otherwise; same syntax and placeholders as --convert-command. frmcmp writes its .pld next to the module unless told otherwise, so give it Output_File={out}. environmentVariables.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.
environmentVariables.name: CB_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.
environmentVariables.name: CB_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.
environmentVariables.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.
environmentVariables.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.
environmentVariables.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to allow disable write operations across both KV and query. KV write tools are not loaded and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow data modification queries and tools.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS

environmentVariables.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level CB_MCP_LOG_<LEVEL>_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB

environmentVariables.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_MAX_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB

environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB

environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB

environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB

environmentVariables.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT

environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for ERROR; inherits it when unset.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT

environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for WARNING; inherits it when unset.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT

environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for INFO; inherits it when unset.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT

environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for DEBUG; inherits it when unset.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT

environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint of the identity provider used to verify bearer JWT signatures. Required to enable OAuth, along with CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER and CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE. Only honored when CB_MCP_TRANSPORT=http.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI

environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT 'iss' claim value. Also advertised as the authorization server in Protected Resource Metadata when CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL is set. Required to enable OAuth.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER

environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT 'aud' claim value. Required to enable OAuth.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: JWT signing algorithm. One of RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512. Default is RS256.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM

environmentVariables.description: Public base URL of this MCP server. When set, the server publishes RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at <base_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp so PRM-aware clients can discover the authorization server. Optional.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'read' access; advertised in PRM and matched against the token's scope/scp claim. Use when your IdP cannot emit the canonical form. Default is couchbase-mcp:read.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL

environmentVariables.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'write' access; same semantics as CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL. Default is couchbase-mcp:write.
environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_WRITE_LABEL

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.
environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_MAX_BYTES

The DuckDB binding ships with the server, so this variable is the only switch.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT

environmentVariables.description: HTTP session model: 'auto', 'stateful', or 'stateless'. This server requires 'stateful' over HTTP — the consent prompt on destructive and outbound calls is a multi-round-trip request that a 2025-era HTTP client can only complete over a live session — so an HTTP start with 'stateless' is refused. 'auto' resolves to 'stateful'; stdio ignores the setting.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE

environmentVariables.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter
environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES

environmentVariables.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

environmentVariables.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DEVICE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DTYPE

environmentVariables.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

'dynamic' (alias 'search'): expose only the ionos_search_tools / ionos_describe_tools / ionos_call_tool meta-tools and browse the full catalog through them — for clients with hard tool caps and no tool search of their own (Cursor, Windsurf).

environmentVariables.description: Opt in to write operations. Unset (default) leaves the server read-only: only list_/get_/head_ tools are registered. 'write' additionally registers create_/update_ tools and the non-disruptive actions (start_, resume_, attach_, assign_); 'destructive' also registers delete_ and the disruptive actions (stop_, reboot_, suspend_, upgrade_, restore_, detach_, recreate_, import_) and implies 'write'. Comma-separated, case-insensitive, hierarchical; unrecognised values stay read-only. WARNING: enabling this lets an AI model provision, modify and delete billable resources in a live IONOS CLOUD account. Every create and delete requires a two-phase confirmation, but that cannot stop a client configured to approve tool calls automatically. Leave unset unless writes are needed.

packageArguments.description: Comma separated values of preview features that are enabled.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) pinned as the creation date of every generated document: reproducible bytes on any host. A call's own creationDate still wins. An invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE

environmentVariables.description: reproducible-builds.org convention: integer seconds since the Unix epoch, used as the pinned creation date when PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE is unset. An invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH

environmentVariables.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH

environmentVariables.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS

servers.name: io.github.Nizoka/zipnative-mcp
servers.title: zipnative MCP — ZIP creation, inspection, secure extraction & verification

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the one sandbox directory: zipPath / sourcePath inputs are read from it and outputMode='file' / outputDir outputs are written under it (never overwritten; the real path of every file read and of every parent written must stay inside — a planted symlink or junction is SECURITY_VIOLATION). Unset: every tool works on base64 only (no file I/O beyond the opt-in cache).
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches zipPath / sourcePath inputs, file output, defaultDate='now', parallel, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntryUncompressedSize and limits.maxTotalUncompressedSize in bytes (default 8589934592 = 8 GiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntries and scan_zip_forward maxEntries (default 100000, the engine default; the scanner's default budget of 10000 is clamped to it, only an explicit value above it is refused). Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for create_zip parallel.workers (default 8; with no explicit workers the engine default max(1, min(cores - 1, 8)) applies, bounded by this ceiling; 0 disables worker threads and keeps compression on the calling thread). Integer >= 0, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS

data_volume.description: Docker volume or host directory holding the OAuth credentials and the transaction cache. Without it the container starts but every tool reports that it is not configured, and anything authorised is lost when the container is replaced.

uid_gid.description: Your own user and group id, as `uid:gid` (run `id -u`:`id -g`). The container runs as root otherwise, and anything it writes into the mounted directory becomes root-owned - after which a host-side `ticktick-mcp` can no longer update its session-token cache and falls back to a signon TickTick throttles.

data_volume.description: Absolute path to the host directory of an ALREADY AUTHORISED setup - it must already hold the cached OAuth token written by running `ticktick-mcp auth` in a terminal. Not an empty volume and not a relative path: the OAuth step cannot run inside the container, and a container without a cached token reads standard input, which is the JSON-RPC channel. Also holds the .env, the v2 session token and the completion-tracking database.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE

environmentVariables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation, then records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model holding the human's token cannot self-attest. Set trust-auth instead to attribute to the authenticated caller with no confirmation, which is safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI. Set off to hide the tool, leaving attestation to external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY

The default 'auto' picks hybrid when embeddings are configured and keyword when they are not. Pin 'keyword' to keep unqualified searches off the embedding provider (each hybrid or semantic search embeds the query, which costs an API call on a metered provider). A configured semantic/hybrid default also degrades to keyword without embeddings, so no setting can make a vault unsearchable; an explicit mode= argument is never downgraded.

GitLab generates this value; copy the `whsec_` token it shows under Generate signing token rather than inventing one. Deliveries are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the webhook id, timestamp and body, and a delivery older than 5 minutes is rejected.

environmentVariables.description: Secret token for the GitLab push-event webhook, GitLab's plain-text form and the only one below 19.0; also mounts POST /gitlab-webhook. It proves nothing about the body and cannot expire, so prefer the signing token where the GitLab version offers it. Setting both accepts either, which is how an existing webhook migrates.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the summarize tool; setting it enables the tool even without an API key. The bare OPENAI_BASE_URL routes traffic only when a key already enables the feature.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Chat model id used for summaries.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Upper bound on generated tokens per summarize call; on reasoning models this budget also covers internal reasoning tokens.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of notes summarised in one call (subtree expansion truncates to this many).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_NOTES

environmentVariables.description: Aggregate cap on note characters sent to the model in one call; excess is truncated with a flag on the result.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_INPUT_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single summarize backend call; keep it below the MCP client's request timeout so the server-side error wins the race.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S

environmentVariables.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S

environmentVariables.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a long-running tool call may run in the foreground before it is promoted to a background job and a job handle is returned instead.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_SOFT_DEADLINE_S

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a background-job record (working or finished) is retained for polling before it expires from the store.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_RESULT_TTL_S

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_MAX_PER_SUBJECT

packageArguments.description: Port for the HTTP transport
packageArguments.name: --port

environmentVariables.description: Public base URL of the deployed server, for example `https://mcp.example.com`. Required for OIDC. Also the fallback source of the MCP Apps domain when `app_domain` is unset.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Single shared bearer token; enables bearer auth unless `bearer_tokens_file` is set, which takes precedence.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OIDC discovery document URL, for example `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CONFIG_URL

environmentVariables.description: OIDC client identifier registered with the provider.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OIDC client secret registered with the provider.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Expected `aud` claim; tokens issued for another audience are rejected.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: Scopes a caller must present, space- or comma-separated. Defaults to `openid` in oidc-proxy mode.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_REQUIRED_SCOPES

environmentVariables.description: Scopes advertised to MCP clients in protected-resource metadata, space- or comma-separated. Overrides the default `openid offline_access`; `oidc_required_scopes` is always added on top. Set this when the registered client is not permitted `offline_access`, or to have clients request extra claim scopes (such as `groups`) without also requiring them in every token.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_ADVERTISED_SCOPES

environmentVariables.description: Signing key for issued tokens; used in oidc-proxy mode only. When unset, the key is derived deterministically from `oidc_client_secret`, so tokens survive a restart. Rotating that secret then invalidates every issued token. Set this explicitly to decouple token validity from secret rotation. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Validate the access token instead of the id token.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OIDC_VERIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` (with a warning) on a host where that directory is not usable.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_KV_STORE_URL

environmentVariables.description: MCP Apps iframe domain, used for CSP sandboxing. Overrides the host derived from `base_url`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_APP_DOMAIN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_DENY

environmentVariables.description: Explicit auth-mode override, accepting `remote` or `oidc-proxy` (case- and whitespace-insensitive). When unset the mode is auto-detected from which auth variables are set; the override exists because having all four OIDC variables set is ambiguous between those two modes. Other values are ignored with a warning.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Path to a TOML file mapping bearer tokens to subjects; overrides the single-token `bearer_token` mode.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_TOKENS_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Subject assigned to the single-token bearer mode; ignored when `bearer_tokens_file` is set, since mapped mode carries per-token subjects.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BEARER_DEFAULT_SUBJECT

environmentVariables.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SERVER_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Concise routing context that distinguishes this deployment's material or responsibility.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION

environmentVariables.description: Deployment-specific behavioral policy added to the generated MCP instructions.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA

environmentVariables.description: Legacy: replaces all generated MCP instructions (deprecated; use _INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION for routing and _INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA for policy).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS

environmentVariables.description: Mount path for the MCP endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_HTTP_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Run the server process as this UID; the container entrypoint reassigns ownership of writable paths to match.
environmentVariables.name: PUID

environmentVariables.description: Run the server process as this GID; pair with PUID to match the owner of a mounted volume.
environmentVariables.name: PGID

environmentVariables.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING

environmentVariables.description: Ollama server URL for the ollama embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the Ollama ecosystem convention.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_HOST

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI API key for the voyage embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OPENAI_API_KEY / OLLAMA_HOST convention. Setting it never auto-selects the provider; choose it explicitly with MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=voyage.
environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. Required — the server refuses to start without it. Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SOURCE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault. git_sync also needs managed git mode; create_upload_link needs an HTTP transport.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to refuse a write that would overwrite an existing file when no if_match etag is supplied. Deliberate replacement still works: read the file first, then pass if_match. Unaffected: edit, append, delete, rename.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_WRITE_PROTECT_EXISTING

environmentVariables.description: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DISABLE_APPS_UI

environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEX_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to {SOURCE_DIR}/.markdown_vault_mcp/state.json.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_STATE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the numpy embeddings file; required to enable semantic search.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEXED_FIELDS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REQUIRED_FIELDS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EXCLUDE

environmentVariables.description: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TITLE_FIELD

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SEARCHABLE_FIELDS

environmentVariables.description: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TEMPLATES_FOLDER

environmentVariables.description: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_PROMPTS_FOLDER

environmentVariables.description: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CONVENTIONS_FILE

environmentVariables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE

environmentVariables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation, then records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model holding the human's token cannot self-attest. Set trust-auth instead to attribute to the authenticated caller with no confirmation, which is safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI. Set off to hide the tool, leaving attestation to external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); case and a leading dot are ignored, so PDF and .pdf name the same type. Use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist. A link whose target has a listed extension is not part of the link graph; changing the list rebuilds the index once.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB

environmentVariables.description: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_NOTE_READ_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Mode used when a search call omits 'mode': auto, keyword, semantic, or hybrid. The default 'auto' picks hybrid when embeddings are configured and keyword when they are not. Pin 'keyword' to keep unqualified searches off the embedding provider (each hybrid or semantic search embeds the query, which costs an API call on a metered provider). A configured semantic/hybrid default also degrades to keyword without embeddings, so no setting can make a vault unsearchable; an explicit mode= argument is never downgraded.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DEFAULT_SEARCH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNKS_PER_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SNIPPET_WORDS

environmentVariables.description: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LENGTH_DOWNWEIGHT_ALPHA

environmentVariables.description: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_WORDS

environmentVariables.description: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNK_OVERLAP_WORDS

environmentVariables.description: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FOLDER_WEIGHTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FTS_WEIGHTS

environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: openai, voyage, ollama, or fastembed. Unset auto-detects from the environment (never voyage). Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with openai plus OPENAI_BASE_URL; see the embeddings guide.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Ollama embedding model name.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_CPU_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI embedding model name.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_VOYAGE_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: FastEmbed model name.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_CONTEXT

environmentVariables.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single embedding HTTP call (OpenAI/Ollama). The local FastEmbed backend runs in-process with no network call and ignores this. CPU-only or large-model workloads may need 60-120 s; raise this if batches time out.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Number of chunks sent per embedding request. Smaller batches shorten each request (useful under a tight timeout on slow models) at the cost of more round-trips.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_REPO_URL

environmentVariables.description: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PULL_INTERVAL_S

environmentVariables.description: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PUSH_DELAY_S

environmentVariables.description: Git committer name for auto-commits; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Git committer email for auto-commits.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name); overrides GIT_COMMIT_NAME per request when an OIDC token is present. The claim is resolved when the tool call arrives and carried to the background commit, so it applies on every write. A configured claim the token does not carry is reported once at WARNING and the static identity is used.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME_CLAIM

environmentVariables.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email); overrides GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL per request when an OIDC token is present. Resolved and carried the same way as the name claim.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL_CLAIM

environmentVariables.description: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_LFS

environmentVariables.description: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull is active or a webhook can deliver (HTTP/SSE transports only). Requires the file-watcher extra.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER

environmentVariables.description: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_S

environmentVariables.description: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_ROOT_FLOOR

environmentVariables.description: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Signing token for the GitLab push-event webhook (GitLab 19.0+); when set, mounts POST /gitlab-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events. GitLab generates this value; copy the `whsec_` token it shows under Generate signing token rather than inventing one. Deliveries are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the webhook id, timestamp and body, and a delivery older than 5 minutes is rejected.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Secret token for the GitLab push-event webhook, GitLab's plain-text form and the only one below 19.0; also mounts POST /gitlab-webhook. It proves nothing about the body and cannot expire, so prefer the signing token where the GitLab version offers it. Setting both accepts either, which is how an existing webhook migrates.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the summarize tool; setting it enables the tool even without an API key. The bare OPENAI_BASE_URL routes traffic only when a key already enables the feature.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Upper bound on generated tokens per summarize call; on reasoning models this budget also covers internal reasoning tokens.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of notes summarised in one call (subtree expansion truncates to this many).

environmentVariables.description: Aggregate cap on note characters sent to the model in one call; excess is truncated with a flag on the result.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_INPUT_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single summarize backend call; keep it below the MCP client's request timeout so the server-side error wins the race.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S

environmentVariables.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S

environmentVariables.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a long-running tool call may run in the foreground before it is promoted to a background job and a job handle is returned instead.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_SOFT_DEADLINE_S

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a background-job record (working or finished) is retained for polling before it expires from the store.
environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_RESULT_TTL_S

Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain (permanent) + Base (permanent) + Mantle limited-time (2026-08-21~08-28 UTC+9), 500 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. Avalanche trial has ended. BNB and Base payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).
environmentVariables.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB Chain + Base) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB and Base payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.

environmentVariables.description: Optional Base Builder Code for onchain attribution (ERC-8021 / Base Builder Codes). When set, every q402_x402_fetch payment includes your code as the client/intermediary in the x402 payment extension so payments are attributed onchain. Format: 1-32 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. Leave unset to disable attribution.

environmentVariables.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET

environmentVariables.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM

environmentVariables.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX

environmentVariables.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP

environmentVariables.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS

environmentVariables.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS

environmentVariables.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT

packageArguments.description: Directory for write approvals, rate-limit counters and the local audit log. Defaults to ~/.rfphub and must be writable — rate limiting fails closed. Pass it where this user has no writable home, and pass the same directory to `rfphub-mcp approve`.

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the RFP Hub API. Defaults to https://api.ethrfps.app. The origin of this URL is bound into every write approval.
environmentVariables.name: RFPHUB_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: RFP Hub API credential. Needed ONLY to submit; searching and fetching are anonymous and never send it. Setting it is what registers the write tool at all: without it tools/list returns two tools. The key must carry the write scope and must not carry publish; the server checks that before its first submission, so a submission waits for a reviewer's decision.
environmentVariables.name: RFPHUB_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Your Theagora API key (starts with agora_live_)
environmentVariables.name: THEAGORA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Default: OpenAI cloud. Use http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for the endpoint above. Use 'ollama' as a sentinel value when running locally against Ollama.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Model identifier used for the synthesize node. Defaults to 'gpt-5-mini'; set to 'gemma3:4b' for Mac-local Ollama.

environmentVariables.description: Model for the plan / classify / critic / compress / verify nodes. Defaults to 'gpt-5-nano'.
